meta.about: Hand-checked High level / Budget gear, applied over bosses.json when the site loads (bosses.json is regenerated from the Wiki guides by scripts, this file is not). A gear entry is an item key, or a list of keys that count as equal (owning any one covers the slot; if none are owned it's priced at the first). dropSupplies removes guide supply lines that don't fit the setup.
meta.rules: Strategy page Equipment table, best (left) column. Follow footnotes where a cell has '/', otherwise take the cheaper item. Drop items made redundant by a 2h weapon; keep the special attack row. Content needing several styles combines the tables (ToB: all melee, all ranged, 5 magic pieces).

high.source: Wiki: Theatre of Blood/Strategies, Equipment (Melee + Ranged tabs, 5 Magic pieces), checked with the user 24 Nov 2026
